title: Northbeam TechWorks Contract Entitlement Note: Visits Taken as Creditable
content:
The pool those visits stand in is read from the visits credited and used on the job the relief is granted against. On a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job, the visits standing in that pool are the visits credited over the visit term of the service less the visits used over it, never falling below nothing, and which of them count as creditable is read from the grounds the credited visits were granted on.

**Where visits stand in that pool and visits granted under a plan covering the item stand among them**, every visit standing in the pool is creditable.

**Where the visits standing in the pool were granted only as a gesture of goodwill**, none of them is creditable.

**Where neither situation holds**, the visits creditable are the visits standing in the pool less the planned visits the service carries each year, never below nothing.

## The readings side by side

| Visits standing in the pool | Grounds among the credited visits | Visits creditable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| one or more | at least one granted under a plan covering the item | every visit standing in the pool |
| any | granted only as a gesture of goodwill | nothing |
| one or more | neither of the above | the visits standing in the pool less the planned visits the service carries each year |
| none | no plan grant among them | nothing, the pool being empty |

The first reading takes precedence, so a pool holding a plan grant alongside a goodwill grant is creditable in full.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

**A plan grant in the pool.** 4 visits were credited over the visit term, one of them granted under a plan covering the item, and 2 have been used; 2 stand in the pool. Every one of them is creditable, so 2 visits are creditable.

**Goodwill grants only.** All 3 visits credited over the term were granted as a gesture of goodwill, and 1 has been used; 2 stand in the pool. None of them is creditable.

**Neither.** 4 visits were credited under a contract renewal and 2 used, so 2 stand in the pool, on a service carrying 2 planned maintenance visits each year. The visits creditable are 2 less 2, which is nothing.

**Neither, on a service carrying no planned maintenance.** 4 credited and 1 used leave 3 in the pool, and the service carries no planned maintenance visits, so 3 visits are creditable.
